_note: What a unit of energy costs the household. Prices are observed at a date and will move; the model reads them, it does not forecast them.

petrolPerLitre.source: MIMIT Osservatorio prezzi carburanti, benzina self-service, media nazionale settimanale al 14/09/2026 (https://www.mimit.gov.it/it/prezzo-medio-carburanti)

electricityHomePerKwh.source: ARERA, prezzo di riferimento cliente domestico vulnerabile in Maggior Tutela, III trimestre 2026, tasse incluse (https://www.arera.it/comunicati-stampa)

electricityPublicPerKwh.rationale: public AC/DC mix, 2026 operator tariffs without subscription

realUseUplift.rationale: real-use consumption over WLTP; ICCT on-road gap studies put full hybrids around 10–15%
